"""Bounded live comprehension validation, then one gated production smoke call."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import traceback

import requests
from dotenv import dotenv_values

from experiments.methods.v23_3.memory_compaction_offline_001.compact import compact_memory, validate_view
from .probes import build_probe, score_answers
from src.skill_evolution.v23 import grouping
from src.skill_evolution.v23.preconditioner import compile_effective_plan
from src.skill_evolution.v23_3.update_patch import normalize_update_patches
from src.skill_evolution.v22.diagnosis_editor import parse_json_response


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[3]
OFFLINE = HERE.parent / "memory_compaction_offline_001"
SOURCE_FILES = [HERE / "run.py", HERE / "probes.py", HERE / "PROTOCOL.md",
                OFFLINE / "compact.py", OFFLINE / "MODEL_FORMAT.md",
                HERE.parent / "p3a_transport_retry_001/run.py",
                HERE.parent / "p3a_first_live_comparison_001/run.py",
                ROOT / "src/skill_evolution/v23/grouping.py",
                ROOT / "src/skill_evolution/v23/preconditioner.py",
                ROOT / "src/skill_evolution/v23_3/update_patch.py"]
LABELS = ("R05", "R06", "production_B")
PROBE_SYSTEM = """You are validating comprehension of a historical evidence input format.
This is a factual reading test, not a request to modify a Skill or generate a Plan.
Answer the supplied questions using only the accompanying compact payload. Do not
reconstruct omitted facts from guesses or memory summaries. Return one JSON object:
{"answers": {"question_id": answer_object, ...}}. Use exactly the question IDs and
the fields/types requested in each question. Return original strings exactly when
asked. No extra fields, commentary, explanations or reasoning transcript.
"""


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")


def environment():
    env = dotenv_values(ROOT / ".env")
    base = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or env.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL")
    key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") or env.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    assert base and key, "Existing model route and credential required"
    cfg = grouping.call_configuration(base_url=base, model="deepseek-v4.1-flash",
                                      max_tokens=16384, timeout=300)
    assert cfg["endpoint"] == "http://llm-proxy.intra.xiaojukeji.com/chat/completions"
    assert cfg["model"] == "deepseek-v4.1-flash"
    return key, cfg


def prepare():
    _, cfg = environment()
    for label in LABELS:
        case = "P3A_B" if label == "production_B" else label
        folder = OFFLINE / "cases" / case
        full, payload = read(folder / "original_payload.json"), read(folder / "compact_payload.json")
        assert payload["memory"] == compact_memory(full["memory"])
        validate_view(payload["memory"], full["memory"])
        assert {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "memory"} == {
            k: v for k, v in full.items() if k != "memory"}
        save(HERE / "config" / label / "full_payload.json", full)
        save(HERE / "config" / label / "compact_payload.json", payload)
        if label == "production_B":
            messages = read(folder / "compact_messages.json")
            assert json.loads(messages[1]["content"]) == payload
            max_tokens = 32768
        else:
            questions, expected = build_probe(full, payload, case=label)
            save(HERE / "config" / label / "questions.json", questions)
            save(HERE / "config" / label / "expected.json", expected)
            messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content": PROBE_SYSTEM + "\n" +
                 (OFFLINE / "MODEL_FORMAT.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")},
                {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps({"questions": questions, "payload": payload},
                                                     ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))},
            ]
            max_tokens = 16384
        body = {k: v for k, v in cfg.items() if k not in ("endpoint", "timeout_seconds")}
        body.update(max_tokens=max_tokens, messages=messages)
        req = {"endpoint": cfg["endpoint"], "timeout": [60, 300], "body": body,
               "max_http_requests": 1}
        save(HERE / "config" / label / "request.json", req)
        size = len(requests.Request("POST", req["endpoint"], json=body).prepare().body)
        print("FROZEN", label, "request_bytes", size, "max_tokens", max_tokens, flush=True)
    save(HERE / "config/freeze.json", {
        "at": now(), "route_config": cfg, "max_logical_calls": 3, "max_http_requests": 3,
        "sources": {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in SOURCE_FILES},
        "no_editor_replay_or_memory_write": True,
    })


def verify_frozen():
    frozen = read(HERE / "config/freeze.json")
    key, cfg = environment()
    assert cfg == frozen["route_config"]
    for rel, content in frozen["sources"].items():
        assert (ROOT / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8") == content, f"Frozen source changed: {rel}"
    for label in LABELS:
        case = "P3A_B" if label == "production_B" else label
        folder, dest = OFFLINE / "cases" / case, HERE / "config" / label
        full, compact = read(dest / "full_payload.json"), read(dest / "compact_payload.json")
        assert full == read(folder / "original_payload.json")
        assert compact == read(folder / "compact_payload.json")
        req = read(dest / "request.json")
        if label == "production_B":
            expected_messages = read(folder / "compact_messages.json")
        else:
            questions, expected = build_probe(full, compact, case=label)
            assert questions == read(dest / "questions.json") and expected == read(dest / "expected.json")
            expected_messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content": PROBE_SYSTEM + "\n" +
                 (OFFLINE / "MODEL_FORMAT.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")},
                {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps({"questions": questions, "payload": compact},
                                                     ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))}]
        expected_body = {k: v for k, v in cfg.items() if k not in ("endpoint", "timeout_seconds")}
        expected_body.update(max_tokens=32768 if label == "production_B" else 16384,
                             messages=expected_messages)
        assert req == {"endpoint": cfg["endpoint"], "timeout": [60, 300], "body": expected_body,
                       "max_http_requests": 1}
    return key


def production_gate(results):
    return all(results.get(label, {}).get("status") == "probe_passed" for label in ("R05", "R06"))


def transport():
    # Reuse the already exercised single-request transport and non-secret send audit.
    path = HERE.parent / "p3a_transport_retry_001/run.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("compact_live_transport", path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.send_once


def run(label):
    assert label in LABELS
    key = verify_frozen()
    if label == "production_B":
        results = {case: read(HERE / "results" / f"{case}.json") for case in ("R05", "R06")}
        assert production_gate(results), "Both factual probes must pass before production generation"
    req = read(HERE / "config" / label / "request.json")
    save(HERE / "results" / f"{label}_claim.json", {"at": now(), "max_http_requests": 1})
    out = HERE / "runs" / label
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    save(out / "messages.json", req["body"]["messages"])
    dest = out / "http/001"
    dest.mkdir(parents=True)
    started = time.monotonic()
    meta = {"label": label, "started_at": now(), "stage": "transport",
            "status": "started", "http_requests_started": 0}
    try:
        send = transport()
        meta["http_requests_started"] = 1
        response = send(req, key, dest, {"connect_upload_timeout_seconds": 60,
                                      "read_timeout_seconds": 300})
        save(out / "response.json", response)
        (out / "raw_output.txt").write_text(response.get("content", ""), encoding="utf-8")
        meta.update(stage="completion", finish_reason=response.get("finish_reason"),
                    usage=response.get("usage"), response_model=response.get("response_model"),
                    content_chars=len(response.get("content", "")))
        assert response.get("finish_reason") == "stop", "Incomplete model response; no resampling"
        meta["stage"] = "parse"
        parsed = parse_json_response(response["content"])
        save(out / "parsed.json", parsed)
        if label != "production_B":
            meta["stage"] = "factual_checks"
            evaluation = score_answers(parsed, read(HERE / "config" / label / "expected.json"))
            save(out / "evaluation.json", evaluation)
            meta.update(status="probe_passed" if evaluation["passed"] else "probe_failed",
                        correct=sum(c["passed"] for c in evaluation["checks"].values()),
                        questions=len(read(HERE / "config" / label / "expected.json")))
        else:
            meta["stage"] = "patch_compile"
            full = read(HERE / "config" / label / "full_payload.json")
            normalized, effective = normalize_update_patches(parsed, full)
            assert compile_effective_plan(normalized, full) == effective
            save(out / "preconditioner.json", normalized)
            save(out / "effective_plan.json", effective)
            meta.update(status="compiled", decision=parsed["decision"],
                        patch_count=sum(bool(a["to"]) for a in parsed["adjustments"]),
                        adjustment_count=len(parsed["adjustments"]),
                        manual_evidence_review_required=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        (out / "traceback.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
        meta.update(status="failed", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
    finally:
        meta.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
        save(out / "run.json", meta)
        save(HERE / "results" / f"{label}.json", meta)
    print(json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1] == "prepare":
        prepare()
    else:
        run(sys.argv[1])

from copy import deepcopy
import json

from experiments.methods.v23_3.memory_compaction_offline_001.compact import (
    menus_for, validate_view,
)


def build_probe(original, compact, *, case):
    memory, view = original["memory"], compact["memory"]
    validate_view(view, memory)
    questions, expected = [], {}

    def add(qid, question, answer):
        questions.append({"id": qid, "question": question})
        expected[qid] = deepcopy(answer)

    def step(key, n):
        return memory["sources"][key]["run"]["steps"][n - 1]

    def full_state(key, n, side):
        source = view["sources"][key]
        for w in source["windows"]:
            if w["start"] <= n <= w["end"]:
                i = n - w["start"]
                state = (w["before"] if i == 0 else w["after"][i - 1]) if side == "before" else w["after"][i]
                assert state == step(key, n)[side]
                return state
        raise ValueError("Probe assumes unavailable detailed state")

    add("window_start",
        "Return the exact before-state of S1_R03/Q2:23 as "
        '{"observation": string, "commands_ref": string_or_null}.',
        full_state("S1_R03/Q2", 23, "before"))
    add("inside_window",
        "Return the exact before-state of S1_R03/Q4:13 as "
        '{"observation": string, "commands_ref": string_or_null}.',
        full_state("S1_R03/Q4", 13, "before"))

    # Find a real same-name, different-content local menu collision across contexts.
    candidates = {}
    collision = None
    for key, source in view["sources"].items():
        if "run" not in source:
            continue
        for cid, commands in menus_for(view, source).items():
            for prior_key, prior_commands in candidates.get(cid, []):
                if prior_key.split("/")[0] != key.split("/")[0] and prior_commands != commands:
                    collision = [(prior_key, cid, prior_commands), (key, cid, commands)]
                    break
            if collision:
                break
            candidates.setdefault(cid, []).append((key, commands))
        if collision:
            break
    assert collision is not None
    a, b = collision
    add("menu_namespaces",
        f"Resolve local command table {a[1]} separately in {a[0]} and {b[0]}. "
        'Return {"first":{"count":integer,"first_three":[strings]},'
        '"second":{"count":integer,"first_three":[strings]},"same_contents":boolean}. '
        "First/second refer to those sources in the order given; preserve list order.",
        {"first": {"count": len(a[2]), "first_three": a[2][:3]},
         "second": {"count": len(b[2]), "first_three": b[2][:3]},
         "same_contents": False})
    key, n = "S1_R04/Q3", 5
    state = full_state(key, n, "before")
    commands = menus_for(view, view["sources"][key])[state["commands_ref"]]
    add("operation_precondition",
        'For S1_R04/Q3:5 return {"before_observation":string,"commands_ref":string,'
        '"pool_ref":string,"heat_is_listed":boolean,"action":string}. '
        'heat_is_listed tests the exact command "heat potato 3 with microwave 1" '
        "in the before-state menu, not whether heat later succeeded.",
        {"before_observation": state["observation"], "commands_ref": state["commands_ref"],
         "pool_ref": view["sources"][key]["command_sets"][state["commands_ref"]],
         "heat_is_listed": "heat potato 3 with microwave 1" in commands,
         "action": step(key, n)["action"]})
    add("omitted_precondition",
        'For S1_R03/Q6:26 return {"action":string,'
        '"recorded_action_in_admissible_commands":boolean,'
        '"exact_before_observation":string_or_null,"complete_before_menu":array_or_null}. '
        "Use null when the exact before-state/menu is not supplied. Do not infer it from "
        "nearby/repeated actions or the recorded legality flag.",
        {"action": step("S1_R03/Q6", 26)["action"],
         "recorded_action_in_admissible_commands":
             step("S1_R03/Q6", 26)["feedback"]["action_in_admissible_commands"],
         "exact_before_observation": None, "complete_before_menu": None})
    add("omitted_after",
        'For S1_R03/Q2:36 return {"action":string,"exact_after_observation":string_or_null}. '
        "Use only explicitly supplied state evidence; repeating a location does not "
        "authorize reconstructing an omitted observation.",
        {"action": step("S1_R03/Q2", 36)["action"], "exact_after_observation": None})
    trace = view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q2"]["run"]["trace"]
    add("whole_trace",
        'Across the entire S1_R03/Q2 trace, return {"countertop2_steps":[step_ID_strings],'
        '"countertop3_steps":[step_ID_strings],"trace_length":integer,"outcome":object}. '
        'Match the exact actions "go to countertop 2" and "go to countertop 3".',
        {"countertop2_steps": [s["step"] for s in trace if s["action"] == "go to countertop 2"],
         "countertop3_steps": [s["step"] for s in trace if s["action"] == "go to countertop 3"],
         "trace_length": len(trace), "outcome": view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q2"]["run"]["outcome"]})
    actions = ["take bread 1 from diningtable 1", "cool bread 1 with fridge 1",
               "move bread 1 to countertop 1"]
    trace = view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q4"]["run"]["trace"]
    add("action_order",
        'In S1_R03/Q4, return {"steps":[step_ID_strings],"success":boolean}, listing the '
        "first occurrence of each exact action in this requested order: " + json.dumps(actions) + ".",
        {"steps": [next(s["step"] for s in trace if s["action"] == action) for action in actions],
         "success": view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q4"]["run"]["outcome"]["success"]})
    source = view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q2"]
    add("coverage",
        'For S1_R03/Q2 return {"detail_coverage":string,"detailed_step_count":integer,'
        '"omitted_detail_ranges":[[start,end],...]}. Count only steps inside declared windows, '
        "not additionally exposed boundary states.",
        {"detail_coverage": source["detail_coverage"],
         "detailed_step_count": sum(w["end"] - w["start"] + 1 for w in source["windows"]),
         "omitted_detail_ranges": source["omitted_detail_ranges"]})
    add("mixed_response",
        'Compare S1_R03/P2 and S1_R03/Q2. Return '
        '{"parent_success":boolean,"parent_steps":integer,'
        '"candidate_success":boolean,"candidate_steps":integer}.',
        {"parent_success": view["sources"]["S1_R03/P2"]["run"]["outcome"]["success"],
         "parent_steps": len(view["sources"]["S1_R03/P2"]["run"]["trace"]),
         "candidate_success": view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q2"]["run"]["outcome"]["success"],
         "candidate_steps": len(view["sources"]["S1_R03/Q2"]["run"]["trace"])})
    source_keys = [k for k in view["sources"] if k.startswith("S1_R03/") and not k.endswith("/diff")]
    add("source_coverage",
        'For historical context S1_R03 return {"supplied_execution_sources":integer,'
        '"all_ten_parent_candidate_pairs_supplied":boolean}. Count only actual sources, '
        "not claims in knowledge or present-round runs.",
        {"supplied_execution_sources": len(source_keys),
         "all_ten_parent_candidate_pairs_supplied":
             all(f"S1_R03/{side}{i}" in source_keys for side in ("P", "Q") for i in range(1, 11))})
    if case == "R06":
        assert full_state("S1_R05/P6", 3, "after") and full_state("S1_R05/Q6", 16, "after")
        add("instance_vs_category",
            'Compare the reached locations at S1_R05/P6:3 and S1_R05/Q6:16. Return '
            '{"parent_location":string,"candidate_location":string,"same_receptacle_type":boolean}. '
            'Use location names as written in actions, without the "go to " prefix. '
            "Evaluate the raw evidence even if knowledge describes a new family.",
            {"parent_location": step("S1_R05/P6", 3)["action"].removeprefix("go to "),
             "candidate_location": step("S1_R05/Q6", 16)["action"].removeprefix("go to "),
             "same_receptacle_type": True})
        diff = memory["sources"]["S1_R05/diff"]["diff"]
        fragment = next(line for line in diff.splitlines()
                        if line.startswith("+") and "distinct receptacle families" in line)
        fragment = fragment.split("distinct receptacle families", 1)[1].split(".", 1)[0].strip()
        add("actual_edit",
            'In the ADDED search instruction of S1_R05/diff, return {"continuation":string}: '
            'the exact text after "distinct receptacle families" and before the next period. '
            "Trim surrounding whitespace and exclude the period. Read actual Diff, not knowledge.",
            {"continuation": fragment})
        add("absence_boundary",
            'Can the compact records for S1_R05/P7 and Q7 establish that no exact butterknife '
            'exists anywhere in the environment? Return {"global_absence_proven":boolean}. '
            "Base this on the evidence coverage, not on treating knowledge as an oracle.",
            {"global_absence_proven": False})
    return questions, expected


def score_answers(parsed, expected):
    require_shape = isinstance(parsed, dict) and set(parsed) == {"answers"} and isinstance(parsed["answers"], dict)
    if not require_shape:
        return {"passed": False, "schema_valid": False, "checks": {}}
    answers = parsed["answers"]
    exact = lambda value: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    checks = {qid: {"passed": qid in answers and exact(answers[qid]) == exact(answer),
                    "expected": answer, "actual": answers.get(qid)}
              for qid, answer in expected.items()}
    return {"passed": set(answers) == set(expected) and all(c["passed"] for c in checks.values()),
            "schema_valid": True, "unexpected_ids": sorted(set(answers) - set(expected)), "checks": checks}

# 紧凑 Memory：有限真实格式验证

本轮由用户授权真实模型验证输入理解。先验证格式，再在通过后进行一次实际 V23.3 生成。不是新增在线检索阶段，不增加后续正式 Preconditioner 的模型调用次数。

## 输入与调用预算

- 固定 `memory_evidence_view_v1`、±2 窗口及原活跃 Memory；使用前一离线实验已生成的 R05、R06 紧凑 payload。两例覆盖共享历史 M6/M7，并由 R06 覆盖 M10 概括冲突。没有加入 Test 或未来记忆。
- 两次格式探针保留完整紧凑 payload（含当前证据），使用专门格式检查系统说明及固定问题，**不使用生产 Preconditioner Prompt**。用于证明指定读取任务能否正确完成，不用于评价策略优劣。
- 两次探针全部通过后，才发第三次请求：原 P3-B 的紧凑 messages，原 V23.3 方法 Prompt 加既有 MODEL_FORMAT 说明；不附探针问题、参考答案或本轮回答，不重新生成 Diagnosis。
- 最多 **3 次逻辑调用、3 次 HTTP 请求**，每项只发送一次，无自动/技术/语义重试。失败或截断不补采样。R05/R06 各独立检查；任一未通过则不发生产生成请求。
- 内网 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`，temperature=1、thinking enabled、reasoning_effort=medium、stream=false；连接/正文发送及读取超时 `(60,300)`，禁重定向，不使用环境代理。
- 探针 max_tokens=16384；生产生成 max_tokens=32768。生产上限是为这轮新验证预先增加的独立预算，不能声称与旧 16384 结果形成方法优劣对照。最多 65536 completion tokens 的配置上限，不含输入，不保证服务端会执行/计费所有额度。
- 保存实际请求、字节数、socket 发送超时、HTTP 原文、模型 response、finish_reason、usage 和错误堆栈。不输出或归档认证头/密钥。费用按实际返回记录；货币费用未知时不估填。

## 探针与通过条件

发送前从完整归档及紧凑视图交叉核验参考答案，并把问题、答案、请求与本协议冻结归档。模型只收到问题，不收到答案。

探针覆盖窗口起点与窗口内状态重建、局部 C ID 到全局命令表的解析、跨来源命名空间、动作合法性前提、缺失状态不可恢复、完整动作序列、配对正反结果、窗口覆盖与不完整来源集合。R06 另检查 M10 的位置/类别区别、实际修改限定与“未找到不能证明不存在”。

每题要求指定结构的简短事实答案。JSON 解码后的字段、类型与值逐项精确比较，不根据内部 reasoning 打分，不用第二个 LLM 作裁判。不要求输出推理过程。所有题通过且正常 finish=stop 才通过该探针；技术失败/截断记未取得有效验证，不能记理解错误。

问题是已知开发案例上的定向测试，不是随机/未见样本。探针通过仅支持这些格式和边界的读取能力，不证明所有输入都理解正确，也不证明与完整输入语义等价。

## 生产生成与后续结论

第三次请求若执行，必须正常结束、可解析、满足原 Patch 契约，并以保存的原始 full payload 完成规范化及 V23 编译；紧凑 view 不冒充原完整 Memory。手工核对最终内容中的历史依据是否为实际提供的证据，是否跨越缺失状态、是否把 Memory 概括当事实、是否破坏 Goal/必要行为。

正常 keep/no_change/need_evidence 是合法输出，但没有实际 Patch 时只能称输出契约/停点验证，不能称非空 Patch 生成成功。程序编译成功也不能证明策略正确或未来行为收益。

- 探针通过且生产输出通过契约、证据边界核查：建议作为**可选输入方式**接入后续有限实验，原完整模式保留。
- 任一必要检查未通过：不宣布整体通过、不默认接入，归档具体失败原因。
- 无论结果如何，最多执行上述调用后停止。无 Editor、Actor、Replay、Memory commit、完整进化、正式 A/B 优劣结论或 Test。

既有源码与所有历史归档保持不变。本轮只新增本目录文件，不提交或改写默认配置。

"""Offline model-input view. Does not replace V23 Memory or its validators."""
from copy import deepcopy
import json

from src.skill_evolution.v23.memory import validate_memory


FORMAT = "memory_evidence_view_v1"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def ranges(numbers):
    """Inclusive, sorted, disjoint ranges; adjacent windows are merged."""
    result = []
    for n in sorted(set(numbers)):
        if result and n == result[-1][1] + 1:
            result[-1][1] = n
        else:
            result.append([n, n])
    return result


def anchors_for(memory):
    anchors = {}
    for entry in memory["entries"]:
        for ref in entry["evidence"]:
            context, local = ref.rsplit("/", 1)
            if local == "diff":
                continue
            run_id, _, position = local.partition(":")
            positions = anchors.setdefault(f"{context}/{run_id}", set())
            if position.isdecimal():
                positions.add(int(position))
    return anchors


def compact_memory(memory, *, radius=2, full=False, shared_menus=True):
    """Deterministic projection, without semantic ranking or generated summaries.

    With full=True, preserve every state and original command table. The compact
    full representation can be restored exactly. Window mode intentionally omits
    detailed states/menus outside the declared windows, never actions/feedback.
    """
    validate_memory(memory)
    require(type(radius) is int and radius >= 0, "radius must be a nonnegative integer")
    view = {
        "format": FORMAT,
        "policy": {"radius": radius, "full": full, "shared_menus": shared_menus},
        "entries": deepcopy(memory["entries"]),
        "sources": {},
        "command_pool": {},
    }
    anchors = anchors_for(memory)
    menu_ids = {}

    def menu_value(commands):
        if not shared_menus:
            return deepcopy(commands)
        encoded = json.dumps(commands, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        if encoded not in menu_ids:
            mid = f"menu_{len(menu_ids) + 1}"
            menu_ids[encoded] = mid
            view["command_pool"][mid] = deepcopy(commands)
        return menu_ids[encoded]

    for key, source in memory["sources"].items():
        if key.endswith("/diff"):
            view["sources"][key] = deepcopy(source)
            continue
        run = source["run"]
        n = len(run["steps"])
        localized = anchors.get(key, set())
        complete = full or not localized
        selected = set(range(1, n + 1)) if complete else {
            step for anchor in localized
            for step in range(max(1, anchor - radius), min(n, anchor + radius) + 1)
        }
        windows, states = [], [run["initial"]]
        for start, end in ranges(selected):
            before = run["steps"][start - 1]["before"]
            after = [s["after"] for s in run["steps"][start - 1:end]]
            windows.append({"start": start, "end": end,
                            "before": deepcopy(before), "after": deepcopy(after)})
            states.extend([before, *after])
        used = {state["commands_ref"] for state in states} - {None}
        # Full mode also preserves unused original menu keys, if any.
        menus = {cid: menu_value(commands) for cid, commands in source["command_sets"].items()
                 if complete or cid in used}
        view["sources"][key] = {
            "run": {
                "ref": run["ref"], "task": run["task"],
                "initial": deepcopy(run["initial"]),
                "trace": [{k: deepcopy(s[k]) for k in ("step", "action", "feedback")}
                          for s in run["steps"]],
                "outcome": deepcopy(run["outcome"]),
            },
            "detail_reason": ("full_baseline" if full else
                              "unlocalized_reference" if not localized else "reference_windows"),
            "detail_coverage": "complete" if len(selected) == n else "partial",
            "windows": windows,
            "omitted_detail_ranges": ranges(set(range(1, n + 1)) - selected),
            # Local C IDs are scoped to this source; values refer to shared exact lists.
            "command_sets": menus,
        }
    return view


def menus_for(view, source):
    if view["policy"]["shared_menus"]:
        return {cid: view["command_pool"][mid] for cid, mid in source["command_sets"].items()}
    return source["command_sets"]


def validate_view(view, original):
    """Check raw facts, windows, references and namespaces against the archive."""
    validate_memory(original)
    require(view["format"] == FORMAT, "Unexpected view format")
    require(view["entries"] == original["entries"], "Memory entries changed")
    require(set(view["sources"]) == set(original["sources"]), "Historical sources changed")
    radius, full = view["policy"]["radius"], view["policy"]["full"]
    require(type(radius) is int and radius >= 0, "Invalid radius")
    require(type(full) is bool and type(view["policy"]["shared_menus"]) is bool, "Invalid policy")
    anchors = anchors_for(original)
    counts = {"runs": 0, "steps": 0, "detailed_steps": 0, "full_runs": 0,
              "fallback_full_runs": 0, "edit_sources": 0, "windows": 0}
    used_pool = set()
    for key, old in original["sources"].items():
        source = view["sources"][key]
        if key.endswith("/diff"):
            require(source == old, "Historical edit/context changed")
            counts["edit_sources"] += 1
            continue
        run, projected = old["run"], source["run"]
        for field in ("ref", "task", "initial", "outcome"):
            require(projected[field] == run[field], f"{key}: {field} changed")
        trace = [{k: s[k] for k in ("step", "action", "feedback")} for s in run["steps"]]
        require(projected["trace"] == trace, f"{key}: action/feedback sequence changed")
        n, detailed, last_end = len(trace), set(), 0
        states = [projected["initial"]]
        for window in source["windows"]:
            start, end = window["start"], window["end"]
            require(type(start) is int and type(end) is int and last_end < start <= end <= n,
                    f"{key}: invalid window coordinates")
            require(window["before"] == run["steps"][start - 1]["before"],
                    f"{key}: window start state changed")
            expected = [s["after"] for s in run["steps"][start - 1:end]]
            require(window["after"] == expected, f"{key}: window states changed")
            detailed.update(range(start, end + 1))
            states.extend([window["before"], *window["after"]])
            last_end = end
        localized = anchors.get(key, set())
        expected_steps = set(range(1, n + 1)) if full or not localized else {
            i for i in range(1, n + 1) if any(abs(i - anchor) <= radius for anchor in localized)
        }
        require(detailed == expected_steps, f"{key}: detail selection differs from policy")
        require([[w["start"], w["end"]] for w in source["windows"]] == ranges(detailed),
                f"{key}: windows not merged")
        require(source["omitted_detail_ranges"] == ranges(set(range(1, n + 1)) - detailed),
                f"{key}: omitted detail ranges incorrect")
        require(source["detail_coverage"] == ("complete" if len(detailed) == n else "partial"),
                f"{key}: completeness falsely declared")
        reason = "full_baseline" if full else "unlocalized_reference" if not localized else "reference_windows"
        require(source["detail_reason"] == reason, f"{key}: fallback reason incorrect")
        used = {s["commands_ref"] for s in states} - {None}
        menus = menus_for(view, source)
        expected_keys = set(old["command_sets"]) if full or not localized else used
        require(set(menus) == expected_keys, f"{key}: missing/extra visible command menus")
        require(all(menus[cid] == old["command_sets"][cid] for cid in menus),
                f"{key}: menu contents or source namespace changed")
        if view["policy"]["shared_menus"]:
            used_pool.update(source["command_sets"].values())
        counts["runs"] += 1
        counts["steps"] += n
        counts["detailed_steps"] += len(detailed)
        counts["full_runs"] += len(detailed) == n
        counts["fallback_full_runs"] += not full and not localized
        counts["windows"] += len(source["windows"])
    require(used_pool == set(view["command_pool"]), "Unused/missing global menu definitions")
    return counts


def restore_complete_memory(view):
    """Refuse to reconstruct unobserved states from a partial model-input view."""
    restored = {"entries": deepcopy(view["entries"]), "sources": {}}
    for key, source in view["sources"].items():
        if key.endswith("/diff"):
            restored["sources"][key] = deepcopy(source)
            continue
        require(source["detail_coverage"] == "complete", "Cannot restore omitted historical states")
        run = source["run"]
        states = {}
        for w in source["windows"]:
            states.update({w["start"] + i: state for i, state in enumerate(w["after"])})
        steps, previous = [], run["initial"]
        for i, item in enumerate(run["trace"], 1):
            require(i in states, "Missing state in complete view")
            steps.append({**deepcopy(item), "before": deepcopy(previous), "after": deepcopy(states[i])})
            previous = states[i]
        restored["sources"][key] = {
            "run": {k: deepcopy(run[k]) for k in ("ref", "task", "initial", "outcome")},
            "command_sets": deepcopy(menus_for(view, source)),
        }
        restored["sources"][key]["run"]["steps"] = steps
    validate_memory(restored)
    return restored

## Historical Memory evidence view

`memory.format = memory_evidence_view_v1` is a model-input projection, not the
complete stored Memory. Entries and evidence references are unchanged. Historical
edit sources still contain their original Parent, actual Diff and execution
context. Do not accept a knowledge claim as verified merely because it is listed.

Every historical execution contains its original task, initial state, outcome and
the complete ordered `trace` of step IDs, actions and raw feedback. A trace omits
observations and candidate menus except where detailed windows supply them.

Each window covers inclusive step numbers `start..end`. Its `before` is the full
state immediately before `start`; `after[i]` is the full state after step
`start+i`. Within a window the next before-state equals the preceding after-state.
`omitted_detail_ranges` explicitly identifies steps without full before/after
evidence; the initial state and each window boundary may additionally expose a
neighboring state. Never fill a gap by carrying a state across it.

Each state's local `commands_ref` resolves in that source's `command_sets`.
If `policy.shared_menus` is true, each local value is a key into the top-level
`command_pool`; otherwise it is the original command list. C IDs in different
sources have separate namespaces. A null command reference is unknown, not empty.

Precise evidence anchors are expanded by the fixed radius in `policy`. Sources
without a numeric anchor retain all details. All actions, feedback and outcomes
remain visible regardless of detail coverage. Do not infer an omitted observation,
inventory condition, candidate list, or object absence. An action trace can show
recorded actions and order; it cannot establish all state-dependent preconditions.
Cite original context-qualified source/step IDs. If the supplied detail is
insufficient for a state-dependent change, state the limitation rather than
inventing evidence. No additional evidence-reading or model-selection call is
available in this input format.

"""Authorized A/B rerun: same frozen bodies; explicit (60, 300) transport."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import traceback

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
E = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD = E.parent / "p3a_first_live_comparison_001"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("p3a_frozen_source", OLD / "run.py")
base = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(base)
import requests
from src.skill_evolution.v23 import grouping, preconditioner as v23
from src.skill_evolution.v23_3 import diagnosis, preconditioner as v233
from src.skill_evolution.v23_3.update_patch import normalize_update_patches
from src.skill_evolution.v22.diagnosis_editor import parse_json_response

read, save, now = base.read, base.save, base.now
active_send = None


def audit(event, args):
    if event == "http.client.send" and active_send is not None:
        conn, data = args
        # Never serialize data or headers; lengths and socket state suffice.
        active_send["events"].append({
            "at": now(), "bytes": len(data), "is_body": len(data) == active_send["body_bytes"],
            "socket_timeout_seconds": conn.sock.gettimeout() if conn.sock is not None else None})


sys.addaudithook(audit)


def prepare():
    base.verify_frozen()
    _, _, cfg = base.env_config()
    assert cfg == read(OLD / "config/call_config.json")
    save(E / "config/transport.json", {"connect_upload_timeout_seconds": 60,
                                     "read_timeout_seconds": 300, "max_http_per_arm": 3})
    save(E / "config/freeze.json", {
        "at": now(), "source_experiment": str(OLD), "same_request_bodies": True,
        "diagnosis_reused": str(OLD / "runs/diagnosis"),
        "call_config": cfg, "protocol": (E / "P3A_RETRY_PROTOCOL.md").read_text()})
    for arm in ("A", "B"):
        save(E / f"config/{arm}_request.json", read(OLD / f"requests/{arm}.json"))
    print("Frozen rerun; no Diagnosis call", flush=True)


def send_once(req, key, dest, transport):
    global active_send
    timeout = (transport["connect_upload_timeout_seconds"], transport["read_timeout_seconds"])
    assert timeout == (60, 300)
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.trust_env = False
        assert all(a.max_retries.total == 0 for a in session.adapters.values())
        prepared = session.prepare_request(requests.Request(
            "POST", req["endpoint"], json=req["body"], headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}))
        body = prepared.body
        assert isinstance(body, bytes)
        assert json.loads(body) == req["body"]
        active_send = {"body_bytes": len(body), "events": []}
        save(dest / "request.json", {"endpoint": req["endpoint"], "body": req["body"],
                                    "timeout": list(timeout), "actual_body_bytes": len(body),
                                    "content_length": int(prepared.headers["Content-Length"]),
                                    "allow_redirects": False, "transport_retries": 0})
        try:
            raw = session.send(prepared, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=False)
            (dest / "http_response.txt").write_bytes(raw.content)
            save(dest / "http_status.json", {"status_code": raw.status_code, "received_at": now()})
            if not 200 <= raw.status_code < 300:
                raise ValueError(f"Model API returned HTTP {raw.status_code}")
            return grouping.response_value(raw.json())
        finally:
            save(dest / "send_events.json", active_send)
            active_send = None


def generate(arm, out):
    base.verify_frozen()
    _, key, cfg = base.env_config()
    freeze = read(E / "config/freeze.json")
    assert cfg == freeze["call_config"]
    assert freeze["protocol"] == (E / "P3A_RETRY_PROTOCOL.md").read_text()
    assert (E / "config/original_protocol.md").read_bytes() == (OLD / "P3A_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md").read_bytes()
    req = read(E / f"config/{arm}_request.json")
    assert req == read(OLD / f"requests/{arm}.json")
    transport = read(E / "config/transport.json")
    assert transport == {"connect_upload_timeout_seconds": 60, "read_timeout_seconds": 300, "max_http_per_arm": 3}
    save(E / f"results/{arm}_claim.json", {"at": now(), "max_http": 3})
    for attempt in range(1, 4):
        dest = out / "http" / f"{attempt:03}"
        dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        started = time.monotonic()
        meta = {"arm": arm, "attempt": attempt, "started_at": now(), "timeout": [60, 300]}
        error = None
        try:
            response = send_once(req, key, dest, transport)
            save(dest / "response.json", response)
            meta["status"] = "response_received"
        except Exception as exc:
            error = exc
            (dest / "traceback.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            code = read(dest / "http_status.json")["status_code"] if (dest / "http_status.json").exists() else None
            transient = code in (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) or (
                isinstance(exc, (requests.Timeout, requests.ConnectionError))
                and not isinstance(exc, requests.exceptions.SSLError))
            meta.update(status="technical_failure", transient=transient,
                        error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
        finally:
            meta.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
            save(dest / "attempt.json", meta)
            print(arm, attempt, meta["status"], round(meta["elapsed_seconds"], 2), flush=True)
        if error is None: return response
        if not meta["transient"] or attempt == 3: raise error
        time.sleep(5 if attempt == 1 else 10)


def run(arm):
    assert arm in ("A", "B")
    if arm == "B": assert (E / "results/A_execution.json").exists()
    original = diagnosis.load_diagnosis(OLD / "runs/diagnosis")
    saved = read(OLD / "config/common_saved.json")
    assert saved == {**original, "memory": read(OLD / "config/memory.json")}
    payload = v23.preconditioner_input(saved)
    assert payload == read(OLD / "config/common_payload.json")
    req = read(E / f"config/{arm}_request.json")
    assert req["body"]["messages"] == (v23 if arm == "A" else v233).messages_for(saved)
    assert read(E / "config/A_request.json")["body"]["messages"][1] == read(E / "config/B_request.json")["body"]["messages"][1]
    out = E / "runs" / arm
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    save(out / "input.json", saved)
    save(out / "messages.json", req["body"]["messages"])
    started = time.monotonic()
    meta = {"arm": arm, "started_at": now(), "stage": "transport"}
    try:
        response = generate(arm, out)
        save(out / "response.json", response)
        (out / "raw_output.txt").write_bytes(response["content"].encode())
        meta.update(stage="completion", finish_reason=response.get("finish_reason"),
                    response_model=response.get("response_model"), usage=response.get("usage"))
        assert response.get("finish_reason") == "stop", "Model response did not finish normally"
        meta["stage"] = "parse"
        parsed = parse_json_response(response["content"])
        save(out / "parsed.json", parsed)
        meta["stage"] = "schema_patch_compile"
        normalized, effective = ((parsed, v23.compile_effective_plan(parsed, payload)) if arm == "A"
                                 else normalize_update_patches(parsed, payload))
        save(out / "preconditioner.json", normalized)
        save(out / "effective_plan.json", effective)
        assert v23.compile_effective_plan(normalized, payload) == effective
        meta.update(status="valid", decision=parsed["decision"], stage="complete")
        save(out / "validation.json", {"valid": True, "effective_null": effective is None})
    except Exception as exc:
        (out / "traceback.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
        meta.update(status="technical_failure", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
        save(out / "validation.json", {"valid": False, "stage": meta["stage"],
                                      "error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)})
    meta.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    save(out / "run.json", meta)
    save(E / f"results/{arm}_execution.json", meta)
    print(json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1] == "prepare": prepare()
    else: run(sys.argv[1])

"""One R05 live experiment: immutable inputs, bounded transport retries, no rollout."""
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
E = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = E.parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import requests
from dotenv import dotenv_values
from src.skill_evolution.v22.diagnosis_editor import parse_json_response
from src.skill_evolution.v23 import grouping, memory, preconditioner as v23
from src.skill_evolution.v23_3 import diagnosis, preconditioner as v233
from src.skill_evolution.v23_3.update_patch import normalize_update_patches

S = ROOT / "artifacts/methods/v23/v23_alfworld_formal_001/S1"
GD = S / "rounds/R05/grouping/attempts/002"


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")


def env_config():
    env = dotenv_values(ROOT / ".env")
    base = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or env.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL")
    key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") or env.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    assert base and key, "Configured route/credential required"
    return base, key, grouping.call_configuration(
        base_url=base, model="deepseek-v4.1-flash", max_tokens=16384, timeout=300)


def request(messages, cfg):
    return {"endpoint": cfg["endpoint"], "timeout_seconds": cfg["timeout_seconds"], "attempts": 1,
            "body": {**{k: v for k, v in cfg.items() if k not in ("endpoint", "timeout_seconds")},
                     "messages": messages}}


def budget(messages):
    encoded = json.dumps(messages, ensure_ascii=False)
    assert len(encoded) <= 4000000 and len(encoded.encode()) <= 6000000
    return {"message_chars": len(encoded), "message_utf8_bytes": len(encoded.encode())}


def prepare():
    assert (E / "P3A_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md").exists()
    grouped = grouping.load_grouping(GD)
    olddir = S / "rounds/R05/preconditioner/attempts/001"
    old, ri = read(olddir / "input.json"), read(S / "rounds/R05/round_input.json")
    mem = memory.load_memory(S / ri["state"]["active_memory"])
    assert mem == ri["memory"] == old["memory"]
    assert mem == json.loads(read(olddir / "request.json")["body"]["messages"][1]["content"])["memory"]
    assert [x["id"] for x in mem["entries"]] == ["M1", "M2", "M3", "M6", "M7", "M8", "M9"]
    assert grouped == {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k not in ("diagnosis", "memory")}
    base, key, cfg = env_config()
    assert cfg["model"] == "deepseek-v4.1-flash"
    save(E / "config/grouping.json", grouped)
    save(E / "config/memory.json", mem)
    save(E / "config/call_config.json", cfg)
    save(E / "config/sources.json", {
        "grouping_directory": str(GD), "round_input": str(S / "rounds/R05/round_input.json"),
        "active_memory": str(S / ri["state"]["active_memory"]), "formal_preconditioner": str(olddir),
        "historical_call_config": read(olddir / "run.json")["call_config"],
        "memory_ids": [x["id"] for x in mem["entries"]], "credential_present": bool(key)})
    for name, path in [("diagnosis_prompt.md", diagnosis.PROMPT_PATH),
                       ("A_preconditioner_prompt.md", v23.PROMPT_PATH),
                       ("B_preconditioner_prompt.md", v233.PROMPT_PATH)]:
        (E / "config" / name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    messages = diagnosis.messages_for(grouped)
    assert "memory" not in json.loads(messages[1]["content"])
    save(E / "requests/diagnosis.json", request(messages, cfg))
    save(E / "config/preflight.json", {
        "frozen_at": now(), "diagnosis_budget": budget(messages), "memory_exact": True,
        "grouping_exact": True, "max_logical_calls": 3, "max_http_per_logical": 3,
        "protocol": (E / "P3A_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md").read_text(),
        "diagnosis_prompt_equals_versioned_source": True, "capacity_probe": False})
    print("FROZEN", json.dumps(budget(messages)), flush=True)


def verify_frozen():
    assert read(E / "config/preflight.json")["protocol"] == (E / "P3A_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md").read_text()
    for name, path in [("diagnosis_prompt.md", diagnosis.PROMPT_PATH),
                       ("A_preconditioner_prompt.md", v23.PROMPT_PATH),
                       ("B_preconditioner_prompt.md", v233.PROMPT_PATH)]:
        assert (E / "config" / name).read_bytes() == path.read_bytes()
    assert read(E / "config/grouping.json") == grouping.load_grouping(GD)
    assert read(E / "config/memory.json") == memory.load_memory(Path(read(E / "config/sources.json")["active_memory"]))


def generator(label):
    """Existing single-HTTP generator; only the preregistered transport failures retry."""
    verify_frozen()
    base, key, cfg = env_config()
    assert cfg == read(E / "config/call_config.json")
    expected = read(E / f"requests/{label}.json")
    inner = grouping.live_generator(base_url=base, key=key, model=cfg["model"],
                                   max_tokens=cfg["max_tokens"], timeout=cfg["timeout_seconds"])
    assert inner.call_config == cfg

    def generate(messages, directory):
        assert request(messages, cfg) == expected
        budget(messages)
        save(E / f"results/{label}_claim.json", {"started_at": now(), "max_http": 3})
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            dest = Path(directory) / "http" / f"{attempt:03}"
            dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            started = time.monotonic()
            meta = {"label": label, "attempt": attempt, "started_at": now()}
            failure = None
            try:
                response = inner(messages, dest)
                save(dest / "response.json", response)
                meta["status"] = "response_received"
            except Exception as exc:
                failure = exc
                code = read(dest / "http_status.json")["status_code"] if (dest / "http_status.json").exists() else None
                transient = code in (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) or (
                    isinstance(exc, (requests.Timeout, requests.ConnectionError))
                    and not isinstance(exc, requests.exceptions.SSLError))
                meta.update(status="technical_failure", http_status=code, transient=transient,
                            error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
            finally:
                meta.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
                if (dest / "request.json").exists():
                    assert read(dest / "request.json") == expected
                save(dest / "attempt.json", meta)
                print(label, attempt, meta["status"], round(meta["elapsed_seconds"], 2), flush=True)
            if failure is None:
                return response
            if not meta["transient"] or attempt == 3:
                raise failure
            time.sleep(5 if attempt == 1 else 10)
    generate.call_config = cfg
    return generate


def run_diagnosis():
    out = E / "runs/diagnosis"
    assert not out.exists(), "Logical call already started; only inspect/reload"
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = {"started_at": now()}
    try:
        saved = diagnosis.run_diagnosis(GD, out, generate=generator("diagnosis"),
                                        max_input_chars=4000000,
                                        call_config=read(E / "config/call_config.json"))
        result.update(status="valid", decision=saved["diagnosis"]["decision"])
    except Exception as exc:
        result.update(status="technical_failure", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
    result.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    save(E / "results/diagnosis_execution.json", result)
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)


def freeze_common():
    verify_frozen()
    assert read(E / "results/diagnosis_gate.json")["passed"] is True
    saved = diagnosis.load_diagnosis(E / "runs/diagnosis")
    saved["memory"] = read(E / "config/memory.json")
    messages = {"A": v23.messages_for(saved), "B": v233.messages_for(saved)}
    payload = v23.preconditioner_input(saved)
    assert messages["A"][1] == messages["B"][1]
    assert json.loads(messages["A"][1]["content"]) == payload
    keep = {"decision": "ready", "reason": "Offline input compatibility only.", "adjustments": [], "checks": None}
    assert v23.compile_effective_plan(keep, payload) == normalize_update_patches(keep, payload)[1] == payload["plan"]
    save(E / "config/common_saved.json", saved)
    save(E / "config/common_payload.json", payload)
    save(E / "config/original_plan.json", payload["plan"])
    cfg = read(E / "config/call_config.json")
    for arm in ("A", "B"):
        save(E / f"requests/{arm}.json", request(messages[arm], cfg))
    save(E / "results/common_input_checks.json", {
        "frozen_at": now(), "same_user_content": True, "same_background": True,
        "same_memory": True, "keep_compiles_both": True,
        "runs": [r["ref"] for r in payload["runs"]],
        "groups": [g["group_id"] for g in payload["grouping"]["groups"]],
        "command_sets": len(payload["command_sets"]),
        "budgets": {arm: budget(messages[arm]) for arm in messages}})


def run_arm(arm):
    assert arm in ("A", "B")
    assert read(E / "results/diagnosis_gate.json")["passed"] is True
    if arm == "B":
        assert (E / "results/A_execution.json").exists(), "A must finish first"
    verify_frozen()
    saved = read(E / "config/common_saved.json")
    loaded = diagnosis.load_diagnosis(E / "runs/diagnosis")
    assert saved == {**loaded, "memory": read(E / "config/memory.json")}
    payload = v23.preconditioner_input(saved)
    assert payload == read(E / "config/common_payload.json")
    req = read(E / f"requests/{arm}.json")
    assert read(E / "requests/A.json")["body"]["messages"][1] == read(E / "requests/B.json")["body"]["messages"][1]
    expected_messages = (v23 if arm == "A" else v233).messages_for(saved)
    assert req["body"]["messages"] == expected_messages
    out = E / "runs" / arm
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    save(out / "input.json", saved)
    save(out / "messages.json", expected_messages)
    (out / "prompt.md").write_text(expected_messages[0]["content"], encoding="utf-8")
    started = time.monotonic()
    meta = {"arm": arm, "started_at": now(), "stage": "transport"}
    try:
        response = generator(arm)(expected_messages, out)
        save(out / "response.json", response)
        (out / "raw_output.txt").write_bytes(response["content"].encode())
        meta.update(stage="completion", finish_reason=response.get("finish_reason"),
                    response_model=response.get("response_model"), usage=response.get("usage"))
        assert response.get("finish_reason") == "stop", "Model response did not finish normally"
        meta["stage"] = "parse"
        parsed = parse_json_response(response["content"])
        save(out / "parsed.json", parsed)
        meta["stage"] = "schema_patch_compile"
        normalized, effective = ((parsed, v23.compile_effective_plan(parsed, payload))
                                 if arm == "A" else normalize_update_patches(parsed, payload))
        save(out / "preconditioner.json", normalized)
        save(out / "effective_plan.json", effective)
        assert v23.compile_effective_plan(normalized, payload) == effective
        meta.update(status="valid", decision=parsed["decision"], stage="complete")
        save(out / "validation.json", {"valid": True, "effective_null": effective is None})
    except Exception as exc:
        meta.update(status="technical_failure", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
        save(out / "validation.json", {"valid": False, "stage": meta["stage"],
                                      "error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)})
    meta.update(finished_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    save(out / "run.json", meta)
    save(E / f"results/{arm}_execution.json", meta)
    print(json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    action = sys.argv[1]
    if action == "prepare": prepare()
    elif action == "diagnosis": run_diagnosis()
    elif action == "freeze_common": freeze_common()
    elif action in ("A", "B"): run_arm(action)
    else: raise ValueError("Unknown stage")

"""One-call Grouping, strict output validation and exact-input persisted reuse."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from src.adapters.alfworld.skill_runtime import write_record
from src.skill_evolution.v22.diagnosis_editor import parse_json_response
from .facts import build_facts, require, text
from .prompts import actor_fields, render_prompt
from .model_routing import model_for_endpoint


PROMPT_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("grouping_prompt.md")


def messages_for(bundle):
    template = PROMPT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    system = render_prompt(template, bundle["background"])
    return [{"role": "system", "content": system},
            {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(bundle["facts"], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))}]


def references(value):
    """Resolve explicit references and common numeric ranges without altering prose."""
    refs = set(re.findall(r"\bP\d+(?::[A-Za-z0-9_]+)?\b", value))
    for match in re.finditer(r"\b(P\d+):(\d+)\s*[-–—]\s*(?:(P\d+):)?(\d+)\b", value):
        prefix, start, end_prefix, end = match.groups()
        require(end_prefix in (None, prefix), "Cross-execution step range")
        start, end = int(start), int(end)
        require(0 <= start <= end <= 10000, "Invalid step range")
        refs.update(f"{prefix}:{i}" for i in range(start, end + 1))
    return refs


def validate_grouping(result, facts):
    require(isinstance(result, dict) and set(result) == {"groups"}, "Expected only groups")
    groups = result["groups"]
    require(isinstance(groups, list) and bool(groups), "Expected nonempty groups")
    runs = {run["ref"]: run for run in facts["runs"]}
    allowed = set(runs)
    for ref, run in runs.items():
        allowed.update({f"{ref}:0", f"{ref}:outcome"})
        allowed.update(event["step"] for event in run["steps"])
    group_ids, assigned = set(), []
    fields = {"group_id", "members", "decision_problem", "shared_basis", "important_differences"}
    for group in groups:
        require(isinstance(group, dict) and set(group) == fields, "Expected exactly five group fields")
        group_id = text(group["group_id"], "group_id")
        require(group_id not in group_ids, "Duplicate group_id")
        group_ids.add(group_id)
        members = group["members"]
        require(isinstance(members, list) and bool(members)
                and all(isinstance(x, str) and x in runs for x in members), "Invalid members")
        assigned.extend(members)
        text(group["decision_problem"], "decision_problem")
        basis = text(group["shared_basis"], "shared_basis")
        differences = group["important_differences"]
        require(isinstance(differences, list), "important_differences must be an array")
        for difference in differences:
            text(difference, "important_difference")
        for prose in [group["decision_problem"], basis, *differences]:
            require(references(prose) <= allowed, "Unresolvable execution/step reference")
            menu_refs = set(re.findall(r"\bC\d+\b", prose))
            require(menu_refs <= set(facts["command_sets"]), "Unresolvable command-set reference")
        basis_refs = references(basis)
        for member in members:
            events = {event["step"] for event in runs[member]["steps"]}
            if not events:
                events = {f"{member}:0"}
            require(bool(events & basis_refs), f"shared_basis lacks a decision-step reference for {member}")
    require(len(assigned) == len(set(assigned)) and set(assigned) == set(runs),
            "Members must cover every execution exactly once")
    for group in groups:
        for prose in [group["decision_problem"], group["shared_basis"], *group["important_differences"]]:
            require(set(re.findall(r"\bG\d+\b", prose)) <= group_ids, "Unresolvable group reference")
    return result


def load_grouping(directory, *, expected_bundle=None, round_id=None,
                  legacy_template=None, expected_call_config=...):
    """Validate archived artifacts before handing facts/grouping to Diagnosis."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    read = lambda name: json.loads((directory / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    bundle = read("input.json")
    if expected_bundle is not None:
        require(bundle == expected_bundle, "Saved grouping input differs from current input")
    meta = read("run.json")
    if round_id is not None:
        require(meta["round_id"] == round_id, "Grouping belongs to a different round")
    messages = messages_for(bundle)
    if legacy_template is not None:
        messages[0]["content"] = actor_fields(legacy_template, bundle["background"])
    require(read("messages.json") == messages, "Saved grouping prompt/input differs")
    if expected_call_config is not ...:
        require(meta.get("call_config") == expected_call_config, "Saved grouping call configuration differs")
    if (directory / "prompt.md").exists():
        require((directory / "prompt.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == messages[0]["content"],
                "Saved grouping prompt differs")
    require(read("validation.json")["valid"] is True, "Saved grouping is not valid")
    result = validate_grouping(read("grouping.json"), bundle["facts"])
    response = read("response.json")
    require(response.get("finish_reason") == "stop", "Saved response was not completed")
    require(parse_json_response(response["content"]) == result, "Saved result differs from model response")
    if (directory / "parsed.json").exists():
        require(read("parsed.json") == result, "Saved parse differs from model response")
    return {"facts": bundle["facts"], "background": bundle["background"],
            "grouping": result, "sources": bundle["sources"], "round_id": meta["round_id"]}


def candidate_groups(saved, task_ids):
    """Reuse Parent membership by paired task identity; never inspect Candidate outcomes."""
    source_by_ref = {source["ref"]: source["task_id"] for source in saved["sources"]}
    by_task = {source_by_ref[member]: group["group_id"]
               for group in saved["grouping"]["groups"] for member in group["members"]}
    require(len(task_ids) == len(set(task_ids)) and set(task_ids) <= set(by_task),
            "Unknown or duplicate Candidate task")
    return {task: by_task[task] for task in task_ids}


def run_grouping(records, directory, *, round_id, generate, max_input_chars=400000, call_config=None):
    """Persist before one semantic attempt; failed directories cannot silently retry."""
    text(round_id, "round_id")
    bundle = build_facts(records)
    messages = messages_for(bundle)
    size = len(json.dumps(messages, ensure_ascii=False))
    require(size <= max_input_chars, "Grouping input exceeds the declared character budget")
    directory = Path(directory)
    generated_config = getattr(generate, "call_config", None)
    require(call_config is None or generated_config is None or call_config == generated_config,
            "Generator configuration differs from declared configuration")
    call_config = call_config if call_config is not None else generated_config
    if directory.exists():
        return load_grouping(directory, expected_bundle=bundle, round_id=round_id,
                             expected_call_config=call_config)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write_record(directory / "input.json", bundle)
    write_record(directory / "messages.json", messages)
    (directory / "prompt.md").write_text(messages[0]["content"], encoding="utf-8")
    meta = {"round_id": round_id, "started_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "input_chars": size, "max_input_chars": max_input_chars, "status": "requesting",
            "call_config": call_config}
    write_record(directory / "run.json", meta)
    try:
        response = generate(messages, directory)
        write_record(directory / "response.json", response)
        (directory / "raw_output.txt").write_text(response.get("content") or "", encoding="utf-8")
        require(response.get("finish_reason") == "stop", "Model response did not finish normally")
        parsed = parse_json_response(response["content"])
        write_record(directory / "parsed.json", parsed)
        result = validate_grouping(parsed, bundle["facts"])
        write_record(directory / "grouping.json", result)
        write_record(directory / "validation.json", {"valid": True, "error": None})
        meta["status"] = "valid"
    except (Exception, KeyboardInterrupt) as exc:
        write_record(directory / "validation.json", {
            "valid": False, "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
            "error": str(exc) if isinstance(exc, ValueError) else "Call failed; inspect preserved response and error type."})
        meta["status"] = "invalid"
        raise
    finally:
        meta["finished_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        write_record(directory / "run.json", meta)
    return load_grouping(directory, expected_bundle=bundle, round_id=round_id,
                         expected_call_config=call_config)


def call_configuration(*, base_url, model, max_tokens, timeout):
    """Non-secret configuration used to distinguish persisted calls."""
    model = model_for_endpoint(base_url, model)
    return {"endpoint": base_url.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions", "model": model,
            "max_tokens": max_tokens, "timeout_seconds": timeout, "temperature": 1.0,
            "reasoning_effort": "medium", "thinking": {"type": "enabled"}, "stream": False}


def response_value(payload):
    """Decode an archived HTTP JSON response using the live response contract."""
    choice = payload["choices"][0]
    return {"content": choice["message"].get("content") or "",
            "finish_reason": choice.get("finish_reason"), "response_model": payload.get("model"),
            "usage": payload.get("usage"), "api_attempts": 1}


def live_generator(*, base_url, key, model, max_tokens=8192, timeout=180):
    """One OpenAI-compatible HTTP request, no semantic or transport retries/hashes."""
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    import requests

    model = model_for_endpoint(base_url, model)
    parsed = urlsplit(base_url)
    require(parsed.scheme in {"http", "https"} and parsed.hostname and not parsed.username
            and not parsed.password and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment, "Invalid API base URL")
    require(bool(key), "API key is not configured")
    require(type(max_tokens) is int and max_tokens > 0 and timeout > 0, "Invalid call budget")
    endpoint = base_url.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"

    def generate(messages, directory):
        body = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": max_tokens,
                "temperature": 1.0, "reasoning_effort": "medium",
                "thinking": {"type": "enabled"}, "stream": False}
        write_record(directory / "request.json", {"endpoint": endpoint, "body": body,
                                                  "timeout_seconds": timeout, "attempts": 1})
        with requests.Session() as session:
            if ".intra." in parsed.hostname:
                session.trust_env = False
            raw = session.post(endpoint, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
                               json=body, timeout=(10, timeout), allow_redirects=False)
        (directory / "http_response.txt").write_bytes(raw.content)
        write_record(directory / "http_status.json", {"status_code": raw.status_code})
        require(200 <= raw.status_code < 300, f"Model API returned HTTP {raw.status_code}")
        return response_value(raw.json())
    generate.call_config = call_configuration(base_url=base_url, model=model, max_tokens=max_tokens, timeout=timeout)
    return generate


def main(argv=None):
    import os
    from dotenv import load_dotenv

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--records", type=Path, nargs="+", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--round-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--convert-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--env-file", type=Path, default=Path(".env"))
    parser.add_argument("--model")
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=8192)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=180)
    parser.add_argument("--max-input-chars", type=int, default=400000)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    records = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for p in args.records]
    if args.convert_only:
        bundle = build_facts(records)
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        write_record(args.output / "input.json", bundle)
        write_record(args.output / "messages.json", messages_for(bundle))
        write_record(args.output / "sources.json", [str(p.resolve()) for p in args.records])
        print(json.dumps({"converted": len(records), "output": str(args.output)}))
        return
    load_dotenv(args.env_file, override=False)
    config = call_configuration(base_url=os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", ""), model=args.model,
                                max_tokens=args.max_tokens, timeout=args.timeout)
    if args.output.exists():
        generate = None  # Reuse needs no credentials and makes no requests.
    else:
        generate = live_generator(base_url=os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", ""),
                                  key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"), model=args.model,
                                  max_tokens=args.max_tokens, timeout=args.timeout)
    result = run_grouping(records, args.output, round_id=args.round_id, generate=generate,
                          max_input_chars=args.max_input_chars, call_config=config)
    print(json.dumps(result["grouping"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
